This video documents a real subculture in Japan. All participants featured gave their consent to be filmed, and identifying details have been intentionally obscured to protect their privacy. We do not condone or encourage illegal activity. This video is presented for documentary and educational purposes only.
Who are we?
We believe life’s greatest moments and deepest connections exist outside your comfort zone. And we also believe in building bridges between people, cultures, and borders by traveling the world and sharing the human stories that remind us how connected we really are.
